step1_analysis.circuit_type: Differential AND/NAND Logic Gate (Swing Limited Logic)
step1_analysis.description: A differential pull-down network for an AND/NAND gate implemented in a current-mode or swing-limited logic (SLL) style. It uses a tail current source and complementary inputs to steer current, providing low-swing, high-speed logic operation.

paper_reference.title: Low-Power High-Performance Arithmetic Circuits and Architectures

propagation_delay.description: Average time delay between the input crossing 50% of its swing and the output crossing 50% of its swing.

sky130_expected.calculation: t_pd ≈ (C_total * V_swing) / I_tail. With W=5u/L=0.5u, parasitics + 10fF load ≈ 25fF. t_pd ≈ (25fF * 0.4V) / 40uA = 250ps.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on 40uA tail current, 400mV swing, and estimated 25fF total capacitance in SKY130 for the given large transistor dimensions.

average_power.description: Average power consumption of the gate during continuous switching.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Static power dominates in CML/SLL. With a 40uA bias current and 1.8V supply, power is roughly 72uW.

energy_per_operation.description: Power-delay product (PDP), representing the energy consumed per logic transition.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated as the product of expected average power and propagation delay in SKY130. Higher than the paper's highly optimized 3fJ due to larger W/L and 1.8V supply.

voltage_swing.description: Difference between logic high (V_OH) and logic low (V_OL) voltage levels.

sky130_expected.reasoning: The testbench is designed with a 10k pull-up resistor and 40uA tail current to explicitly match the paper's 400mV swing.

step3_testbench.description: Transient analysis to measure propagation delay, power consumption, energy per operation, and voltage swing of the SLL AND/NAND gate.
step3_testbench.spice:
* SLL AND/NAND Gate Testbench
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
I_BIAS VDD N_C 40u

* Pull-up resistors to set 400mV swing (40uA * 10k = 400mV)
R1 VDD P1 10k
R2 VDD P2 10k

* DUT
XM4 P1 IN_L1 N_L_MID GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM1 N_L_MID IN_L2 N_TAIL GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM9 P2 IN_R1 N_TAIL GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM2 P2 IN_R2 N_TAIL GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N_TAIL N_C GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM6 N_C N_C GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}

* Complementary Inputs (Swing 1.4V to 1.8V)
VA IN_L1 0 PULSE(1.4 1.8 1n 50p 50p 2n 4n)
VA_BAR IN_R1 0 PULSE(1.8 1.4 1n 50p 50p 2n 4n)
VB IN_L2 0 PULSE(1.4 1.8 2n 50p 50p 4n 8n)
VB_BAR IN_R2 0 PULSE(1.8 1.4 2n 50p 50p 4n 8n)

* Load Capacitors
C1 P1 0 10f
C2 P2 0 10f

.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.control
tran 10p 10n

* Measure Propagation Delay (4 transitions)
meas tran t_delay_fall1 trig v(IN_L2) val=1.6 rise=1 targ v(P1) val=1.6 fall=1
meas tran t_delay_rise1 trig v(IN_L1) val=1.6 fall=1 targ v(P1) val=1.6 rise=1
meas tran t_delay_fall2 trig v(IN_L1) val=1.6 rise=2 targ v(P1) val=1.6 fall=2
meas tran t_delay_rise2 trig v(IN_L2) val=1.6 fall=1 targ v(P1) val=1.6 rise=2

let t_pd = (t_delay_fall1 + t_delay_rise1 + t_delay_fall2 + t_delay_rise2) / 4
print t_pd

* Measure Average Power
meas tran avg_current avg i(VVDD) from=1n to=7n
let avg_power = -avg_current * 1.8
print avg_power

* Measure Energy per Operation (PDP)
let energy_per_op = avg_power * t_pd
print energy_per_op

* Measure Voltage Swing
meas tran v_max max v(P1) from=2n to=4n
meas tran v_min min v(P1) from=2n to=4n
let v_swing = v_max - v_min
print v_swing

quit
.endc
